businesses.business: Harmony Biosciences: specialty pharmaceuticals for rare neurological and sleep disorders

offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription medicines for rare neurological disorders, mainly narcolepsy and other sleep disorders. It sells its approved medicine to US patients through specialty pharmacies and distributors, prescribed by neurologists and sleep specialists, and develops further treatments.

primary_products.value: narcolepsy prescription medicine; pipeline medicines for rare neurological disorders

customer_segment.value: B2B: specialty pharmacies, wholesale drug distributors, hospitals and clinics, pharmaceutical licensing partners

end_markets.value: healthcare; pharmaceuticals; neurology and sleep medicine

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription medicine sold to pharmacies and distributors; licensing or royalties: payments and royalties from partners for rights to its medicines outside the US

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets its own prescription medicines, sold to pharmacies and distributors

geography_served.value: US national: Sells across the United States, with partners selling its medicines in other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on rare neurological and sleep disorders, with a small number of medicines

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty and wholesale drug distributors; third-party retail: specialty pharmacies filling patient prescriptions; partners / resellers: licensing partners selling its medicines outside the US
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicines need US FDA approval to sell, drug safety, marketing and pricing rules apply

notes: Pipeline products, partner arrangements and product lineup may have changed since my information was last updated.
